outcome: Pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation
cohort: Pregnant rats gavaged with nitrogen on embryonic day 9.5 to induce fetal congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH).
finding: Intra-amniotic sildenafil decreased pulmonary vascular muscularization, rosiglitazone increased peripheral pulmonary blood flow distribution, and their combination decreased pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation, indicating an amelioration of the pulmonary hypertensive phenotype of CDH.
followup_time: 2 days (from E19.5 intervention to E21.5 delivery/observation)
